article.title: TPO-12 / Which Hand Did They Use?

glossary.translation: 拉沙佩勒欧圣（地名/化石发现地）

形容词，指在数量或力量上占据优势。

data.text: We all know that many more people today are right-handed than left-handed.
data.translation: 我们都知道，如今右撇子的人数远多于左撇子。
data.grammarFocus: 比较级结构 many more... than...
data.pronounRef: We 指代说话人和听众；that 引导宾语从句。

sentenceCoach.summary: 这是一个简单的比较句，告诉我们右撇子更多。
sentenceCoach.keyHint: 注意 'many more... than' 是比较级的加强形式。

teachingFocus.mainQuestion: 这句话在告诉我们一个什么普遍事实？
teachingFocus.grammarQuestion: 怎么比较右撇子和左撇子的人数谁多谁少？
teachingFocus.modifierQuestion: ‘today’（如今）这个词限定了时间范围，不能忽略哦。
teachingFocus.relationshipQuestion: ‘that’ 后面跟着的是我们‘知道’的具体内容。
teachingFocus.commonMistake: 容易漏掉 'many'，它用来强调右撇子比左撇子多‘很多’。
thinkingPath: 找到主语 We
找到谓语 know
找到 know 的内容（that 从句）
在从句中找比较对象
teachingFocus.encouragement: 太棒了！你一眼就看出了这是在比较人数多少。

data.analysis:
### 【主干结构】
主语：We
谓语：know
宾语：that 引导的宾语从句

### 【从句剖析】
that many more people today are right-handed than left-handed 是宾语从句。
从句主干：people are right-handed.
比较结构：many more ... than ... （比……多得多）。

### 【词汇解析】
right-handed: 右撇子
left-handed: 左撇子

data.text: Can one trace this same pattern far back in prehistory?
data.translation: 我们能否将这一同样的模式追溯到史前时期呢？
data.grammarFocus: 情态动词 Can 引导的一般疑问句；trace...back in...
data.pronounRef: one 指代‘人们/任何人’；this same pattern 指代上一句的右撇子多于左撇子的现象。

sentenceCoach.summary: 这是一个问句，探索历史。
sentenceCoach.keyHint: 注意 trace back 这个短语，意思是‘追溯’。

teachingFocus.mainQuestion: 作者想问我们能不能把现在的习惯追溯到很久以前？
teachingFocus.grammarQuestion: 怎么把‘追溯’这个动作表达出来？
teachingFocus.modifierQuestion: 'far back in prehistory' 是时间状语，告诉我们追溯得有多远。
teachingFocus.relationshipQuestion: this same pattern 指代前一句提到的现象。
teachingFocus.commonMistake: 容易把 one 翻译成‘一个’，这里它泛指‘人们’。
thinkingPath: 找到情态动词 Can
找到主语 one
找到谓语 trace
找到宾语 this same pattern
teachingFocus.encouragement: 你的语感真好，一下就抓住了这个疑问句的核心！

data.analysis:
### 【主干结构】
情态动词：Can
主语：one（泛指人们）
谓语：trace
宾语：this same pattern
状语：far back in prehistory

### 【短语解析】
trace back: 追溯
prehistory: 史前时期

data.text: Much of the evidence about right-hand versus left-hand dominance comes from stencils and prints found in rock shelters in Australia and elsewhere, and in many Ice Age caves in France, Spain, and Tasmania.
data.translation: 关于右撇子与左撇子主导性的许多证据，来自澳大利亚及其他地方的岩棚中发现的模板和印痕，以及法国、西班牙和塔斯马尼亚许多冰河时代洞穴中的发现。
data.grammarFocus: 主谓一致 Much of... comes from...；过去分词 found 作后置定语；并列介词短语 from A and B.

sentenceCoach.summary: 这句话很长，但核心是‘证据来自哪里’。
sentenceCoach.keyHint: 找到 comes from，后面跟着两个由 and 连接的地点。

teachingFocus.mainQuestion: 证据主要来自哪两个地方？
teachingFocus.modifierQuestion: ‘about right-hand versus left-hand dominance’ 是修饰 evidence 的定语。
teachingFocus.relationshipQuestion: ‘and’ 连接了 ‘in Australia...’ 和 ‘in many Ice Age caves...’ 这两个来源。
teachingFocus.commonMistake: 主语是 Much of the evidence，是单数，所以谓语动词用 comes 而不是 come。
thinkingPath: 找到主语 Much of the evidence
找到谓语 comes from
找到第一个来源 stencils and prints...
找到第二个来源（由 and 连接）...
teachingFocus.encouragement: 长句子就像积木塔，只要找到底座（主谓），其他部分就能稳稳搭上去！

data.analysis:
### 【主干结构】
主语：Much of the evidence
谓语：comes from
宾语：stencils and prints

### 【修饰成分】
1. about right-hand versus left-hand dominance: 介词短语作后置定语，修饰 evidence。
2. found in rock shelters... and elsewhere: 过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 stencils and prints。
3. in many Ice Age caves in France, Spain, and Tasmania: 介词短语作后置定语，修饰 stencils and prints（与前面的 found 短语并列，共同说明来源）。

### 【并列结构】
from [stencils and prints found in A] and [in B]
注意：from 管辖了两个部分，第一部分是 stencils...，第二部分是隐含在语境中的证据来源（即 also comes from... caves）。严格来说，结构是 comes from [A] and [in B]，或者理解为 comes from [A] and [B]（B处省略了 stencils and prints）。

segments.text: found in rock shelters in Australia and elsewhere,
segments.label: 定语

segments.text: in many Ice Age caves in France, Spain, and Tasmania.
segments.label: 状语（来源）

data.text: When a left hand has been stenciled, this implies that the artist was right-handed, and vice versa.
data.translation: 当左手被拓印时，这意味着艺术家是右撇子，反之亦然。
data.grammarFocus: When 引导的时间状语从句；被动语态 has been stenciled；that 引导的宾语从句；vice versa.
data.pronounRef: this 指代‘左手被拓印’这一事实。

sentenceCoach.summary: 左手印子意味着右手作者。
sentenceCoach.keyHint: 注意 has been stenciled 是被动语态。

teachingFocus.mainQuestion: 左手印子说明了什么？
teachingFocus.grammarQuestion: ‘this implies that...’ 中 this 指代什么？
teachingFocus.modifierQuestion: When 引导的从句是时间状语。
teachingFocus.relationshipQuestion: vice versa 表示‘右手印子意味着左手作者’。
teachingFocus.commonMistake: 容易忽略 vice versa 的含义，它让句子意思完整对称。
thinkingPath: 找到 When 从句
找到主句主语 this
找到主句谓语 implies
找到 implies 的宾语从句
teachingFocus.encouragement: 你抓住了‘反之亦然’这个关键点，逻辑非常清晰！

data.analysis:
### 【主干结构】
状语从句：When a left hand has been stenciled
主句主语：this
主句谓语：implies
主句宾语：that the artist was right-handed
并列部分：and vice versa

### 【从句剖析】
1. When 从句：时间状语从句，使用现在完成时的被动语态。
2. that 从句：宾语从句，作 implies 的宾语，使用一般过去时。

### 【词汇解析】
vice versa: 反之亦然

data.text: Even though the paint was often sprayed on by mouth, one can assume that the dominant hand assisted in the operation.
data.translation: 尽管颜料经常是用嘴喷上去的，但人们可以假设主导手在操作中起到了辅助作用。
data.grammarFocus: Even though 引导的让步状语从句；被动语态 was sprayed on；that 引导的宾语从句。
data.pronounRef: one 指代‘人们/研究者’；the dominant hand 指‘惯用手’。

sentenceCoach.summary: 虽然嘴喷了颜料，但手也帮忙了。
sentenceCoach.keyHint: 注意 Even though 表示转折让步。

teachingFocus.mainQuestion: 嘴喷颜料和手辅助之间是什么关系？
teachingFocus.grammarQuestion: ‘sprayed on by mouth’ 中 on 的作用？
teachingFocus.modifierQuestion: Even though 从句修饰主句，表示让步。
teachingFocus.relationshipQuestion: one can assume 是主句核心。
teachingFocus.commonMistake: 容易把 sprayed on 分开看，on 是副词小品词，与 spray 构成短语。
thinkingPath: 找到 Even though 从句
找到主句主语 one
找到主句谓语 can assume
找到 assume 的宾语从句
teachingFocus.encouragement: 你成功拆解了让步状语从句，真厉害！

data.analysis:
### 【主干结构】
让步状语从句：Even though the paint was often sprayed on by mouth
主句主语：one
主句谓语：can assume
主句宾语：that the dominant hand assisted in the operation

### 【从句剖析】
1. Even though 从句：让步状语从句，被动语态。
2. that 从句：宾语从句，作 assume 的宾语。

### 【词汇解析】
spray on: 喷上
dominant hand: 惯用手/主导手

data.text: One also has to make the assumption that hands were stenciled palm downward—a left hand stenciled palm upward might of course look as if it were a right hand.
data.translation: 人们还必须做出一个假设：手是掌心向下拓印的——当然，掌心向上拓印的左手看起来可能就像右手。
data.grammarFocus: 同位语从句 that hands were stenciled...；破折号后的补充说明；as if 引导的方式状语从句/表语从句；虚拟语气 were.
data.pronounRef: it 指代 the left hand.
data.logicConnector: 破折号（解释说明）；as if（好像）

sentenceCoach.summary: 假设掌心向下，否则左手可能看像右手。
sentenceCoach.keyHint: 注意破折号后面的内容是解释为什么要有这个假设。

teachingFocus.mainQuestion: 为什么要假设掌心向下？
teachingFocus.grammarQuestion: ‘that hands were stenciled...’ 是什么从句？
teachingFocus.modifierQuestion: palm downward 是方式状语或补足语。
teachingFocus.relationshipQuestion: 破折号后是对前文假设的反面举例。
teachingFocus.commonMistake: as if it were 中的 were 是虚拟语气，表示‘看起来像但实际上不是’。
thinkingPath: 找到主句 One has to make the assumption
找到 assumption 的同位语从句
找到破折号后的补充说明
找到 as if 从句
teachingFocus.encouragement: 你连破折号后的复杂逻辑都理顺了，太棒了！

data.analysis:
### 【主干结构】
主语：One
谓语：has to make
宾语：the assumption
同位语从句：that hands were stenciled palm downward
补充说明（破折号后）：a left hand stenciled palm upward might of course look as if it were a right hand.

### 【从句剖析】
1. that 从句：同位语从句，解释 assumption 的内容。
2. as if 从句：表语从句/方式状语从句，作 look 的补足，使用虚拟语气（were）。

### 【词汇解析】
palm downward: 掌心向下
stenciled palm upward: 掌心向上拓印的

data.text: Of 158 stencils in the French cave of Gargas, 136 have been identified as left, and only 22 as right; right-handedness was therefore heavily predominant.
data.translation: 在法国加尔加洞穴的158个拓印中，136个被鉴定为左手，只有22个是右手；因此右撇子占绝对优势。
data.grammarFocus: Of 引导的介词短语作状语；被动语态 have been identified；分号连接两个独立分句；therefore 表示因果。

sentenceCoach.summary: 数据证明右撇子更多。
sentenceCoach.keyHint: 注意分号前后是因果关系。

teachingFocus.mainQuestion: 数据说明了什么结论？
teachingFocus.grammarQuestion: ‘have been identified as’ 是什么结构？
teachingFocus.modifierQuestion: ‘in the French cave of Gargas’ 修饰 stencils。
teachingFocus.relationshipQuestion: 分号前的数据是原因，分号后的结论是结果。
teachingFocus.commonMistake: 容易忽略 heavily 修饰 predominant，表示‘非常/绝对’。
thinkingPath: 找到状语 Of 158 stencils...
找到主语 136
找到谓语 have been identified
找到分号后的结论
teachingFocus.encouragement: 你通过数据抓住了文章的核心证据，真聪明！

data.analysis:
### 【主干结构】
状语：Of 158 stencils in the French cave of Gargas
分句1主语：136
分句1谓语：have been identified as left
分句1并列部分：and only 22 [identified] as right
分句2主语：right-handedness
分句2谓语：was
分句2表语：heavily predominant

### 【逻辑关系】
分号前的数据（136 vs 22）导致分号后的结论（right-handedness was therefore heavily predominant）。

segments.text: Of 158 stencils in the French cave of Gargas,
segments.label: 状语

data.text: Cave art furnishes other types of evidence of this phenomenon.
data.translation: 洞穴艺术提供了这种现象的其他类型的证据。
data.grammarFocus: 主谓宾结构；furnishes 提供。
data.pronounRef: this phenomenon 指代右撇子现象。

sentenceCoach.summary: 洞穴艺术也是证据来源。
sentenceCoach.keyHint: 注意 furnishes 是‘提供’的意思。

teachingFocus.mainQuestion: 谁提供了证据？
teachingFocus.modifierQuestion: ‘other types of’ 修饰 evidence。
teachingFocus.relationshipQuestion: this phenomenon 指代前文提到的右撇子现象。
teachingFocus.commonMistake: furnishes 比较正式，意思是‘提供’。
thinkingPath: 找到主语 Cave art
找到谓语 furnishes
找到宾语 other types of evidence
找到 evidence 的修饰语
teachingFocus.encouragement: 你准确找到了句子的核心动词，很棒！

data.analysis:
### 【主干结构】
主语：Cave art
谓语：furnishes
宾语：other types of evidence
定语：of this phenomenon（修饰 evidence）

data.text: Most engravings, for example, are best lit from the left, as befits the work of right-handed artists, who generally prefer to have the light source on the left so that the shadow of their hand does not fall on the tip of the engraving tool or brush.
data.translation: 例如，大多数雕刻作品最好从左侧打光，这符合右撇子艺术家的工作习惯，他们通常喜欢光源在左侧，这样他们的手的影子就不会落在雕刻工具或画笔的尖端上。
data.grammarFocus: as befits... 非限制性定语从句；who 引导的非限制性定语从句；so that 引导的目的状语从句。
data.pronounRef: who 指代 right-handed artists；their 指代 artists。
data.logicConnector: for example（插入语）；as（正如）；who（谁）；so that（以便）

sentenceCoach.summary: 解释为什么光要从左边来。
sentenceCoach.keyHint: 注意 as befits 和 who 引导的两个从句。

teachingFocus.mainQuestion: 为什么光要从左边来？
teachingFocus.modifierQuestion: ‘who generally prefer...’ 修饰 artists。
teachingFocus.relationshipQuestion: so that 引导目的状语，解释原因。
teachingFocus.commonMistake: as befits 容易被误认为是谓语，其实 as 是关系代词，引导非限制性定语从句。
thinkingPath: 找到主句 Most engravings are best lit...
找到 as befits... 从句
找到 who 引导的定语从句
找到 so that 目的状语从句
teachingFocus.encouragement: 你成功拆解了层层嵌套的从句，逻辑大师！

data.analysis:
### 【主干结构】
主语：Most engravings
谓语：are best lit
状语：from the left

### 【从句剖析】
1. as befits the work of right-handed artists: as 引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰前面整句话或 lit from the left 这一做法。
2. who generally prefer to have the light source on the left: who 引导的非限制性定语从句，修饰 right-handed artists。
3. so that the shadow of their hand does not fall on the tip of the engraving tool or brush: so that 引导的目的状语从句，修饰 prefer to have...

### 【词汇解析】
engraving: 雕刻
befit: 适合
light source: 光源

segments.text: on the tip of the engraving tool or brush.
segments.label: 状语

data.text: In the few cases where an Ice Age figure is depicted holding something, it is mostly, though not always, in the right hand.
data.translation: 在少数描绘冰河时代人物手持某物的案例中，它（物品）大多（尽管不总是）在右手中。
data.grammarFocus: where 引导的定语从句；though not always 插入语；it 指代 something。
data.pronounRef: it 指代 holding something 中的 something。

sentenceCoach.summary: 手里拿的东西通常在右手。
sentenceCoach.keyHint: 注意 where 引导的定语从句修饰 cases。

teachingFocus.mainQuestion: 手里拿的东西在哪只手里？
teachingFocus.grammarQuestion: ‘where an Ice Age figure is depicted...’ 修饰谁？
teachingFocus.modifierQuestion: though not always 是插入语，表示例外。
teachingFocus.commonMistake: 容易把 where 当作副词，这里它是关系副词，引导定语从句。
thinkingPath: 找到介词短语 In the few cases
找到 where 引导的定语从句
找到主句主语 it
找到主句谓语 is
找到表语 in the right hand
teachingFocus.encouragement: 你抓住了插入语 though not always，细节满分！

data.analysis:
### 【主干结构】
状语：In the few cases
定语从句：where an Ice Age figure is depicted holding something
主句主语：it
主句谓语：is
主句表语：in the right hand
插入语：though not always

### 【从句剖析】
where 引导的定语从句修饰 cases，表示‘在...的情况下’。

data.text: Clues to right-handedness can also be found by other methods.
data.translation: 右撇子的线索也可以通过其他方法找到。
data.grammarFocus: 被动语态 can also be found；by other methods 方式状语。

sentenceCoach.summary: 还有其他方法找线索。
sentenceCoach.keyHint: 注意 can be found 是被动语态。

teachingFocus.mainQuestion: 线索怎么找？
teachingFocus.modifierQuestion: ‘to right-handedness’ 修饰 Clues。
teachingFocus.commonMistake: 无
thinkingPath: 找到主语 Clues
找到谓语 can also be found
找到方式状语 by other methods
teachingFocus.encouragement: 简单明了，你一眼就看出了被动语态！

data.analysis:
### 【主干结构】
主语：Clues
定语：to right-handedness
谓语：can also be found
状语：by other methods

data.text: Right-handers tend to have longer, stronger, and more muscular bones on the right side, and Marcellin Boule as long ago as 1911 noted the La Chapelle-aux-Saints Neanderthal skeleton had a right upper arm bone that was noticeably stronger than the left.
data.translation: 右撇子倾向于在右侧拥有更长、更强壮、肌肉更发达的骨骼，而马塞兰·布勒早在1911年就注意到拉沙佩勒欧圣尼安德特人骨骼的右上臂骨明显比左边的强壮。
data.grammarFocus: tend to do；并列形容词 longer, stronger, and more muscular；and 连接两个独立分句；that 引导的定语从句。
data.pronounRef: the left 指代 the left upper arm bone。

sentenceCoach.summary: 右撇子右边骨头强，布勒发现了证据。

data.grammarFocus: responsible for... 形容词短语作定语；is located in...；suggest that... 宾语从句；asymmetrical 不对称的。

sentenceCoach.summary: 左脑负责精细运动，人脑早就不对称了。
sentenceCoach.keyHint: 注意 responsible for... 修饰 part。

teachingFocus.mainQuestion: 大脑的哪部分负责精细运动？
teachingFocus.modifierQuestion: ‘in its structure and function’ 修饰 asymmetrical。
teachingFocus.relationshipQuestion: and 连接两个并列的发现。
teachingFocus.commonMistake: 主语是 The part，谓语是 is located。
thinkingPath: 找到主语 The part
找到 responsible for... 定语
找到谓语 is located
找到地点状语 in the left cerebral hemisphere
找到 and 后的主语 the findings
找到谓语 suggest
找到 that 宾语从句
teachingFocus.encouragement: 你成功拆解了复杂的定语和宾语从句，真厉害！

data.analysis:
### 【主干结构】
分句1：The part of the brain responsible for fine control and movement is located in the left cerebral hemisphere
分句2：and the findings above suggest that the human brain was already asymmetrical in its structure and function not long after 2 million years ago.

### 【从句剖析】
that the human brain was already asymmetrical...: 宾语从句，作 suggest 的宾语。

### 【词汇解析】
cerebral hemisphere: 大脑半球
asymmetrical: 不对称的

segments.text: responsible for fine control and movement
segments.label: 定语

segments.text: not long after 2 million years ago.
segments.label: 状语

data.text: Among Neanderthalers of 70,000–35,000 years ago, Marcellin Boule noted that the La Chapelle-aux-Saints individual had a left hemisphere slightly bigger than the right, and the same was found for brains of specimens from Neanderthal, Gibraltar, and La Quina.
data.translation: 在7万至3.5万年前的尼安德特人中，马塞兰·布勒注意到拉沙佩勒欧圣个体的左脑半球比右脑半球稍大，在来自尼安德特、直布罗陀和拉基纳的标本大脑中也发现了同样的情况。
data.grammarFocus: Among... 介词短语作状语；noted that... 宾语从句；the same was found... 被动语态。
data.pronounRef: the same 指代 left hemisphere slightly bigger than the right。

sentenceCoach.summary: 尼安德特人脑半球也不对称。
sentenceCoach.keyHint: 注意 noted that... 和 the same was found... 是并列的。

teachingFocus.mainQuestion: 尼安德特人脑半球有什么特点？
teachingFocus.grammarQuestion: ‘that the La Chapelle-aux-Saints individual had...’ 是什么从句？
teachingFocus.modifierQuestion: ‘slightly bigger than the right’ 修饰 left hemisphere。
teachingFocus.commonMistake: the same was found... 中 the same 是主语。
thinkingPath: 找到状语 Among Neanderthalers...
找到主语 Marcellin Boule
找到谓语 noted
找到 that 宾语从句
找到 and 后的主语 the same
找到谓语 was found
找到 for... 状语
teachingFocus.encouragement: 你准确识别了并列结构，真棒！
